gloss: earthbound spirit; ghost bound to a place

definitions.gloss: earthbound spirit; ghost bound to a place
definitions.explanation: In Japanese folklore and horror, the spirit of a dead person that cannot move on and remains tied to a specific location, typically where they died.

examples.japanese: {地縛霊|じばくれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{地縛霊|じばくれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It is rumored that an earthbound spirit haunts this building.

examples.japanese: {地縛霊|じばくれい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{離|はな}れられない→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧⟦{霊|れい}→霊：14667_rei⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: An earthbound spirit is said to be a ghost that cannot leave that place.

notes:
Combines {地縛|じばく} (bound to the ground) with ⟦{霊|れい}→霊：14667_rei⟧ (spirit). A staple of Japanese ghost stories and horror, contrasted with spirits that wander freely.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地縛霊|じばくれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: an earthbound spirit appears
- {地縛霊|じばくれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{憑|つ}かれる→取り憑く：11969_toritsuku⟧: to be possessed by an earthbound spirit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{浮遊霊|ふゆうれい}→浮遊霊：30064_fuyuurei⟧: wandering spirit — not tied to one place
- ⟦{幽霊|ゆうれい}→幽霊：10648_yuurei⟧: ghost — the general term
